defs.def: with no or very little light, especially because it is night 黑暗的；昏暗的；阴暗的

ex.s: After Twenty Years The short story “After Twenty Years” is set in New York on a cold, dark night.
ex.t: 《二十年后》这篇短篇小说背景设在纽约一个寒冷黑暗的夜晚。

ex.s: He had no family, and had never heard a word from Jimmy again since that cold, dark night.
ex.t: 他没有家人，自那个寒冷黑暗的夜晚后再没听到吉米的消息。

ex.s: For example, The street was long and dark, and there was no one around...
ex.t: 例如，街道又长又暗，周围一个人也没有……

ex.s: Last spring in Yellowstone, I followed a path that took me through a dark forest.
ex.t: 去年春天在黄石公园，我沿着一条穿过黑暗森林的小路前行。

ex.s: Since it wasn't dark yet after the meal, I decided to walk home from the restaurant.
ex.t: 因为饭后天还没黑，我决定从餐厅走回家。

ex.s: When the children are walking or ___59___ (cycle) to school on dark mornings, car drivers can ___60___ (easy) see them.
ex.t: 当孩子们在黑暗的早晨步行或____59____（骑车）上学时，司机能____60____（容易）看到他们。

ex.s: Paragraph 2: We had no idea where we were and it was getting dark. _____________
ex.t: 第2段：我们不知道自己在哪里，天渐渐黑了。_____________

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: “时间”与“目的地”的压力进一步阻碍了觉知。我遇到许多徒步者赶往远处营地，只够在天黑前到达。他们很少想到 wander 一下，花片刻看看周围。

ex.s: But it was now getting real dark． If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back． My mum would be worried sick if I didn't come home soon． So I ran back home almost in the dark while trying not to get too scared．
ex.t: 但天色现已真正黑下来。如果我继续走，可能看不清回去的路……

defs.def: not light; closer in shade to black than to white 深色的；暗色的

ex.s: “One strip of darker shells might get you about two cans of smaller tuna, but the red ones are worth more, For the red ones, one strip might get enough tuna to feed a big family for a long time.
ex.t: 一条颜色更深的贝壳可能换来约两罐较小的金枪鱼，但红色的值更多；红色的一条可能换来足够的金枪鱼，养活一大家子很久。

ex.s: Several violins hung from the dark walls, quietly waiting to be chosen.
ex.t: 几把小提琴挂在深色墙上，静静等待被选中。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他别把我分到那个争强好胜、极其严肃的家伙一组，那人总穿深色衣服，性格似乎也与之相配。

defs.def: having a colour that is close to black 近乎黑色的
brown or black in colour 褐色的；黝黑的；乌黑的
having dark hair, eyes, etc. 人

ex.s: My classmates ranged from those kids with pale skin and large blue eyes to those with rich brown skin and dark hair.
ex.t: 我的同学有的肤色苍白、蓝眼睛大大的，有的肤色棕润、头发乌黑。

ex.s: “Yes, sir,” she replied, her dark eyes meeting his.
ex.t: “是的，先生，”她答道，乌黑的眼睛与他对视。

ex.s: With shining dark eyes, he seems like the of kid who would enjoy public speaking.
ex.t: 他闪着乌黑的眼睛，看起来像是会喜欢公开演讲的孩子。

defs.def: mysterious; hidden and not known about 神秘的；隐秘的；隐藏的

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的小镇。一天放学后，在探索青山绿树时，我差点跌在一组台阶上。这些台阶会通向哪里？好奇心占了上风，我知道天就快黑了。我开始爬上那些奇怪而神秘的台阶。

defs.def: evil or frightening 邪恶的；阴险的；凶恶的

ex.s: This is a quick look at life in Uzbekistan, made of friendliness and warmth, but also its darker side of society.
ex.t: 这是对乌兹别克斯坦生活的一瞥，由友好与温暖构成，但也有其社会中较阴暗的一面。

defs.def: unpleasant and without any hope that sth good will happen 忧郁的；不快的；无望的

ex.s: The most memorable scene is towards the end of the movie when, during Mia’s darkest moment of self-doubt, she is touched by a letter her father left her.
ex.t: 最难忘的场景在电影接近结尾时：在米娅最黑暗的自我怀疑时刻，她被父亲留下的信触动。

defs.def: produced with the back part of the tongue close to the back of the mouth. In many accents of English, dark /l/ is used after a vowel, as in ball. 语音
a person who does not tell other people much about their life, and who surprises other people by having interesting qualities 深藏不露的人
a person taking part in a race, etc. who surprises everyone by winning 出人意料的获胜者；黑马
the lack of light in a place, especially because it is night 黑暗；暗处

ex.s: It encourages us to occupy our own little corner, to avoid foolish leaps into the dark, to be satisfied.
ex.t: 它鼓励我们占据自己的小角落，避免愚蠢地跳入黑暗，安于现状。

ex.s: On the edge of the jacket, there is a piece of cloth ___58___gives off light in the dark.
ex.t: 夹克边缘有一块布，____58____在黑暗中发光。

ex.s: Eventually, I got up in the dark and drove to the meeting spot.
ex.t: 最终，我在黑暗中起身，开车前往会面地点。

ex.s: C． The forest in the dark is dangerous for them．
ex.t: C． 黑暗中的森林对它们很危险。

ex.s: 16．（30分）I was ready to pay for my bananas at the grocery one night， when fear seized me． My wallet was gone． I could only have left it on the G9 bus， which was now speeding in the dark to some（1）     station．
ex.t: 16．（30分）一天晚上我在杂货店准备付香蕉钱时，一阵恐惧袭来。我的钱包不见了。我只可能把它落在G9路公交车上，那车正疾驰在黑暗中，开往某个（1）车站。

defs.def: an amount of sth that is dark in colour 暗色；阴影
